h1: Green Hotel & Resort Khon Kaen — Big Rooms, Easy Price in Central Khon Kaen
intro: In Khon Kaen, where new hotels keep going up in tall towers and nudging their prices higher every year, Green Hotel & Resort Khon Kaen still sits among the city stays that give you a big room at an easy price — the kind that's getting hard to find · It's a 3-star city hotel on Prachasamoson Road in the city center, open since 2012 and given a major renovation in 2023 · The thing guests agree on most is rooms that are roomier than the price suggests; many have a balcony and a separate sitting area, comfortable beds, plenty of power outlets, and good cold air conditioning · There's a breakfast buffet, free parking, and large banquet halls that Khon Kaen locals often use for weddings and seminars · From about ฿850/night, rated 9.1 from 149 reviews on Trip.com

body.html: Who Green Hotel & Resort Khon Kaen is for — If you want the shortest possible summary, this is one of Khon Kaen's best city hotels at the "square meters per baht" game · It isn't a stylish design boutique built for social-media photos, and it isn't a luxury hotel with a rooftop pool or a spa to soak in all day · It's a 78-room hotel that focuses on the meat of the matter: big rooms, comfortable beds, and a wallet-friendly price, on a central location in the Prachasamoson Road area · It has been open since 2012 and went through a major renovation in 2023, which makes the rooms and common areas look fresher than peers of the same vintage that have been left to age · It's still operating normally and scores well on booking platforms, with a 9.1 from 149 reviews on Trip.com in the "excellent" range, while on TripAdvisor it sits at around 3.8 out of 5 from a smaller number of reviews · The real reviews line up on who fits here: budget travelers who want lots of space in the room, families coming as a group who want a room they can stretch out in, people who drive their own car and care about free parking, and groups coming to Khon Kaen for a wedding or seminar in the hotel's own banquet halls · As for anyone after modern design, a swimming pool, or a full gym, you may need to look at other hotels in the city instead, because Green Hotel & Resort positions itself as a simple, good-value stay rather than a flashy one

Location and getting around — The hotel sits on Prachasamoson Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Khon Kaen, a central neighborhood that pulls back just slightly from the main road, so you get convenience and quiet at the same time · The reference point most guests use is Central Plaza Khon Kaen, about 5–6 kilometers away, under a 15-minute drive — the city's main shopping and dining hub · Closer than that is Marina Water Park, about 1 kilometer away, and a temple in the same area, Wat Tri Prasit, that's a short walk or drive · As for the popular landmarks, Bueng Kaen Nakhon — the lake in the middle of the city where Khon Kaen locals go to walk for exercise and photograph the sunset — along with the nightlife strip of Khao Niao Road, is a short drive away · For longer trips: it's about 6–7 kilometers from Khon Kaen railway station and about 12 kilometers, or roughly a 20-minute drive, from Khon Kaen International Airport (KKC) · The hotel offers a paid airport transfer that you can book ahead · An honest note from the reviews: this isn't a "walk to everything" location like a hotel attached to a mall downtown — almost every time you head out you'll need your own car or a Grab, which is barely an issue for anyone who drives, but people without a car should budget for daily transport

"The room was way bigger than the price, the bed was comfortable, the air con was nice and cold, and there were plenty of power outlets. I drove my own car and they have free parking right at the hotel, so convenient · The breakfast was made fresh and tastier than I expected, the staff were friendly, and at this price it's a steal."

Room types and decor — Green Hotel & Resort Khon Kaen has 78 rooms in total, split across several types · The entry-level standard rooms are the Superior Twin and Superior Queen at around 28 square meters, which is roomier than the equivalent rooms at many city hotels that usually give you just over 20 square meters · Step up to the Deluxe and the suite category and they get much larger; some have a separate sitting area, a sofa, and enough open space for kids to run around · Most rooms have a private balcony, warm-toned laminate wood floors, and natural-stone accent walls as a highlight, plus a flat-screen TV, a fridge, free drinking water, a hairdryer, and air conditioning that reviews consistently praise as quick to cool and strong · Something guests especially like is the number of power outlets, enough to charge several devices at once — a small detail many hotels overlook · The bathrooms in several room types are well done, with a bathtub in the higher-tier rooms, and some suites are designed so the tub looks through into the bedroom for an open, airy feel · The overall decor is simple in the city-hotel style — not heavy on bold design, but clean and easy to maintain · An honest note from the reviews: even though it was renovated in 2023, the building has been open since 2012, so some rooms still show wear with age, such as furniture or fixtures in spots that are starting to look old, and some reviews say the room lighting is fairly dim, making it hard to read at night — if you're serious about lighting, bring a reading lamp or ask to switch to a brighter room

Facilities and common areas — Let's be straight from the start: Green Hotel & Resort Khon Kaen has no swimming pool and no gym, which is worth knowing before you book, because the word "resort" in the name can mislead some people into thinking it has full resort-style facilities · Its real strength is the meeting and banquet rooms, with 7 to choose from, handling everything from small groups of around 30 up to large events of 700 people · This is why many Khon Kaen locals know this hotel as a venue for weddings, reunions, seminars, and corporate events more than as a place for tourists to stay · The hotel also has the other services you'd expect at city-hotel level, including free private parking — a point reviews praise a lot for people who drive — free Wi-Fi, a paid airport transfer, a hair salon, and full wedding-planning services · The overall feel of the common areas is fairly quiet and calm, suited to people who want a low-key rest, but on the flip side that means if you're looking for a bar, a cafe, or a chill lounge space like a lifestyle hotel, this place may not deliver it

Food and dining — The hotel's main restaurant is Green Zone, serving mostly Thai food, with room service during limited hours · The star of the food story is the breakfast buffet, which many reviews speak about positively, especially for being made fresh and for a well-rounded Isan-Thai flavor · The breakfast set covers steamed rice, curries, stir-fried vegetables, chicken sausage, salad, fruit, toast, and self-serve coffee and tea, which for a hotel at this price is a satisfying spread · Some reviews say the breakfast menu has gotten smaller at times, or that some days items run out fast if you go down late, but overall it still earns more praise than criticism · For other meals, since the location is outside the dense restaurant district, many guests choose to drive or grab a ride into town — to the Central Plaza area, Ton Tan Market, and the well-known Isan restaurants scattered across Khon Kaen · The honest tip is that if you drive your own car, using this hotel as a base to sleep and heading out to eat around town is the best value, because Khon Kaen is a city where Isan food is delicious and inexpensive

Service — Service is a point that earns fairly consistent praise in the real reviews · The words that show up over and over are "friendly staff," "helpful," and "lovely service" — the charm of an upcountry hotel where staff look after guests with genuine warmth rather than formality · Many people say check-in was a warm welcome, and when there were small issues in the room, they reported them and got them fixed within a reasonable time · Since this is a hotel that mainly takes banquet events, the team has experience handling large groups of guests · An honest note: on days when the hotel has a big banquet or lots of guests, some departments may be slower to respond, and room service runs on limited hours, not 24/7 · Overall service is still at a good level and is a plus that lifts the stay above the price you pay

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — Pulling together Trip.com, Agoda, Booking.com, and TripAdvisor, the picture is fairly consistent · On the praise side: rooms bigger than the price is the most-mentioned point, followed by comfortable beds, air con that's quick and strong, plenty of power outlets, fresh and tasty breakfast, free parking that's convenient for drivers, friendly staff and good service, and a quiet, calm atmosphere good for resting · On the gripe side: the most-mentioned complaint is weak water pressure in some rooms' showers and the showerhead design in some rooms being wall-mounted in an awkward spot · Next is fairly dim room lighting that makes rooms look darker than expected, the condition of some spots starting to age with the building dating to 2012 even though it was renovated in 2023, noise carrying from neighboring rooms or the corridor in some rooms with thin walls, and a location that's far from the main attractions, so you need a car almost every time you head out · Most of these complaints are things you can manage by adjusting expectations and choosing the right room rather than big problems that keep people from coming back, especially given how low the starting price is

"Big room, clean, staff who are sweet and genuine in that Isan way · The only catch is the water in the shower runs fairly weak and the room lighting is a touch dim, but compared to what I paid it's still really good. Next time I'm in Khon Kaen I'll stay here again."

Price and value — This is the heart of why Green Hotel & Resort Khon Kaen still holds a place in the market · Starting room rates in the normal range sit at around ฿850–1,000/night, and on some days like Sundays the deals drop below that, while the average reference rate is around ฿1,900/night for higher-tier rooms or during events in town · Compared with other Khon Kaen city hotels offering similar room sizes of 28 square meters and up, this price is among the best value in the city, especially once you count in the free parking, the fresh breakfast, and the genuinely spacious rooms · Compared with design boutiques or 4-star downtown hotels whose starting rates run one to two times higher, Green Hotel & Resort trades away the design, pool, and gym it doesn't have in exchange for a much easier price and a bigger room · For people who measure value mainly by room space and money in the wallet, every baht spent here pays back in full, but for those who value atmosphere, design, and leisure facilities, the value may not match what they're after

What to know before booking — There are a few things that help the stay go more smoothly · One, know from the start that there's no swimming pool and no gym; if those matter for your trip, consider another hotel in the city instead · Two, if you're sensitive to light or like a bright room, ask for a brighter room or bring your own reading lamp, because reviews mention the room lighting being fairly dim · Three, on the weak water pressure in some showers, if you're serious about it, ask or request a room change at check-in · Four, the location is far from the attractions and downtown malls, so having your own car or budgeting for Grab rides makes things much easier, and the hotel's free parking is a clear advantage for drivers · Five, if you come during a wedding or big banquet, you may run into a lively crowd and slightly slower service, so brace for it a little, or ask ahead whether there's a big event during your stay · Six, prices here change a lot by day, so compare across several platforms and choose free cancellation first if your plans aren't firm yet

The verdict — From all the real reviews, Green Hotel & Resort Khon Kaen is the best fit for anyone who wants a big room at an easy price, in a central Khon Kaen location, who cares about free parking · Rooms of 28 square meters and up that are roomier than the price, comfortable beds, good cold air con, fresh breakfast, and friendly staff make it a good-value pick for budget travelers, families, and people coming for a banquet event in town · If you're after modern design, a swimming pool, a gym, or a location where you can walk to malls and food, this may not be the answer, and you should consider a boutique hotel or one attached to a downtown mall instead · But for a trip where you want a big, comfortable bed on a budget you can manage, with the freedom to drive out and eat Isan food around town — Green Hotel & Resort Khon Kaen does its job well and offers more value than the price

faq.a: It's at 179/160 Prachasamoson Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Khon Kaen, in the city-center area · It's about 5–6 kilometers from Central Plaza Khon Kaen, under a 15-minute drive · Near Marina Water Park, about 1 kilometer, and Bueng Kaen Nakhon, about a 10-minute drive · It's about 6–7 kilometers from Khon Kaen railway station and about 12 kilometers, or a 20-minute drive, from Khon Kaen Airport (KKC) · There's free parking and a paid airport transfer

faq.q: How much does Green Hotel & Resort Khon Kaen start at, and what room types are there?

faq.q: Does Green Hotel & Resort Khon Kaen have a swimming pool and a gym?
faq.a: There is no swimming pool and no gym — worth knowing before you book, even though the name says resort · Its strengths are big rooms, an easy price, free parking, and 7 banquet rooms for 30–700 guests · If you want a swimming pool or a gym, consider another hotel in the city instead

faq.q: What are the rooms at Green Hotel & Resort Khon Kaen like, and are they spacious?
